title: Muon LR 0.04 -> 0.06
description: Raised MATRIX_LR (Muon learning rate) from 0.04 to 0.06, one-line change, everything else identical to baseline.
reflection: val_bpb 1.012649 vs baseline 1.014027, a small but real improvement (~0.0014). Pivoted away from my original device-batch-size proposal since it duplicated a3's identical idea, and instead probed an untested lever (Muon LR) to add information the round wasn't otherwise covering. The gain is modest, suggesting 0.04 was close to but not quite optimal; worth bracketing further (e.g. 0.05 or 0.08) in a later round if this direction is picked, but the improvement here is small enough that other proposals (depth scaling, batch throughput) could plausibly beat it.
